supported_combinations.admission: The selected existing member/profile returns a value without a reported error.

invariants: Absent is not a value. A present null/None/nil result remains present and is valid only under its exact existing nullable result contract.

Do not discard a valid partial/full result because an error is reported; do not force an exception where the existing policy retains/logs an error.
Do not create a result on an error-only branch, invent a placeholder error on success, attach new exception fields, or add new public success/error conventions.
